objective: Use a full-scale manual separating screen to recover dry ceramic finishing media into a collection tray while retaining every metal washer in the screen, then release the screen stably onto its supports. This frozen construction specification does not claim feasibility, novelty, or Impact-on-jobs qualification. Development remains blocked pending pinned-runtime/API verification, native component-physics validation, occupational evidence, and resolution of substantial ability overlap with closed, unmerged PR684.
instruction: Pour the intermixed finishing media and metal washers from the feed cup into the separating screen. Use the screen to recover the media in the collection tray while keeping every washer in the screen. Leave the screen resting on its supports.
industrial_mapping: Raytech manufacturer material supports manual separation of manufactured parts from mass-finishing media and provides nominal screen and media dimensions. The simulated operation tests loaded-vessel pouring, bimanual screen control, orientation-dependent aperture passage, bridge clearing, workpiece retention, spill prevention, and stable release. The completed current-scope catalog review found no equivalent task in the six designated public benchmark inventories, but closed, unmerged PR684 tests substantially the same selective-aperture sifting ability; this contract therefore does not claim that the ability is novel. Available evidence also does not establish this operation as a regular core task for qualifying US occupations totaling more than 500,000 workers, so the requested Impact-on-jobs category remains unqualified.
damage_rules: At reset freeze body sets M=24 media bodies, W=4 washer assemblies, S=screen bodies, R=receiver bodies, U=support bodies, C=feed-cup bodies, G=robot/gripper colliders, T=table/floor bodies, O=other task bodies, and A=S∪R∪U∪C. Each washer consists of four rigid arc segments joined by authored break joints. At every completed physics step: resolve physics; sample transforms, joint states, contacts, and signed distances; advance transfer-state machines; latch immutable events; update containment and recovery; update dwell; compute score. O_0 is the settled reset observation and O_57600 is processed before timeout. Camera checks occur separately at 20 Hz.

Define signed penetration p(a,b,k)=max(0,-d_signed(a,b,k)), where d_signed is minimum post-solve collider separation. Screen-fixture penetration is max p over S×(R∪U∪T). Dynamic-body penetration is max p over pairs having at least one member in M∪W and the other in M∪W∪S∪R∪C∪T. Aggregate over every 240 Hz post-physics sample.

For each batch body b, use a causal transfer state machine FEED→EXITED_FEED→FREE_FLIGHT→ENTERED_SCREEN. FEED requires inside_feed. EXITED_FEED latches on an outward swept crossing of the feed-cup rim. FREE_FLIGHT requires subsequent samples outside both feed and screen, with no contact except optional feed-rim contact during the exit segment. ENTERED_SCREEN latches only on a later inward swept crossing through the open screen rim. The states may span any number of physics samples; adjacency is never required. Robot contact with an individual M or W body, contact with any staging surface, entry into the receiver before screen entry, or any non-rim departure permanently invalidates that body's provenance.

The batch opens at the first valid feed exit and batch_loaded latches when all M∪W have reached ENTERED_SCREEN and every washer is inside_screen. Feed-cup emptying does not close recovery eligibility. After batch_loaded, valid aperture crossing and receiver recovery may occur at any later sample, including during subsequent agitation. The scoring episode remains open until timeout.

A washer-loss event latches when any washer segment crosses outward through the screen rim after admission, crosses below the perforated plane without a clear-aperture path, contacts T outside R, becomes inaccessible, or has invalid provenance. Re-entry never clears the event.

A media-spill event latches when media crosses outward through the screen rim, contacts T outside R, exits R after entry, crosses the screen floor outside a clear aperture, becomes inaccessible, or has invalid provenance. Its mass remains permanently recovery-ineligible, and final dwell becomes permanently ineligible.
Receiver contamination latches when any W, C, S, U, or other non-media task body satisfies inside_receiver. It is an immutable hard failure even if the body is removed later.

A body is inaccessible when its center lies outside the frozen reachable-workspace polytope, below z_table-0.02 m, or inside an authored closed fixture volume whose every predefined gripper approach corridor intersects collision geometry. This deterministic predicate does not depend on IK failure.

Washer fracture latches when any authored washer break joint separates or its joint force exceeds its frozen break threshold. Washer permanent deformation latches when, after contact forces remain at most 1 N for one continuous second, any unbroken washer joint retains more than 0.0005 m translational or 2 deg rotational offset from its reset relative transform. Apparatus fracture latches when an authored break joint in A separates. These damage modes are physically realizable rigid-body joint failures, not fitted-dimension changes on immutable rigid meshes.

Any washer loss, receiver contamination, invalid provenance, post-reset pose/velocity write to M∪W∪S∪R∪U∪C, fake grasp weld, required-collider disable, particle freeze, or hidden restoring force is an immutable hard failure and sets score to zero from that physics sample.

Washer fracture or permanent deformation without loss caps score at 0.40. Apparatus fracture caps score at 0.20 and permanently revokes dwell eligibility. Concurrent caps combine by minimum. Media spill does not independently force zero, but permanently removes the affected mass from recovery and revokes dwell eligibility.

Breakage, spill, loss, contamination, and excessive contact remain physically possible. Construction diagnostics do not directly grade the task unless their physical consequences meet a scoring or damage predicate.
assets: Independently authored full-scale separating screen: sourced outer diameter 0.3683 m and depth 0.0635 m; assumed 0.0127 m clear square apertures, 0.003 m ribs/floor, 0.0157 m pitch, 0.150 m perforated radius, 0.003 m walls, 0.40 kg mass, and two grasp tabs.

Twenty-four free rigid ceramic angle-cut cylinders: sourced 0.009525 m diameter by 0.022225 m axial envelope; assumed parallel 15 deg cuts and 2500 kg/m^3 density. Record realized closed-mesh mass and inertia; analytic reference mass is 0.0035044969 kg each.

Four independently authored representative steel washer assemblies: 0.030 m outer diameter, 0.008 m bore, 0.004 m thickness, 7850 kg/m^3 density, and four rigid arc segments connected by breakable fixed joints. Analytic total mass is 0.0206170159 kg per washer; no commercial SKU claim.

Rigid receiver 0.45×0.40×0.08 m with 0.005 m floor/walls; two 0.52×0.015×0.010 m support beams with four legs; rigid feed cup 0.078 m outer diameter×0.100 m high with 0.003 m walls/floor and 0.10 kg empty mass.
Pinned public YAM robot asset and guarded 14D joint-action interface, subject to hash-indexed runtime/API preflight before compatibility is claimed.
Raytech source records s-b442a7fa63fcb80c, s-a3efcebbecba0048, and s-855e796b5a3f8ecc support the operation and nominal screen/media dimensions.
approximations: Only dry rigid-body separation is modeled. Polishing, abrasion, liquids, wet cohesion, dust, wear, and lubrication are excluded.

Clear-hole shape, ribs, pitch, wall profile, screen mass, grasp tabs, media cut angle/density, fixtures, washer geometry, and washer break thresholds are explicit testable assumptions rather than manufacturer CAD or commercial-part specifications.

Initial uncalibrated contacts are ceramic/polymer static/dynamic friction 0.50/0.35, steel/polymer 0.45/0.35, media/media 0.40/0.30, restitution 0.05, contact offset 0.00015 m, rest offset 0 m, and 32/8 position/velocity solver iterations. The 200–250 N washer break-threshold acceptance band, 0.5 mm residual-joint deformation threshold, penetration limits, drift limits, and release clearance are explicit engineering assumptions requiring native validation. No velocity cap or hidden force may suppress adverse outcomes.
Mass scoring uses individually tracked reset masses. A physical trial may use before/after weighing plus continuous video to verify admission, screen passage, spill, retention, and recovery.

The intermixed batch starts entirely in the feed cup; screen and receiver start empty. Assumed centers are screen (0,0.25) m and feed cup (0.31,0.25) m. Support-beam center y values are 0.15 and 0.35 m; support tops and the screen's lowest reset geometry are z=0.13 m above the tabletop.

Boundary-aperture width is computed from collision geometry by intersecting the perforated floor with its plane, enumerating connected clear-space components inside the wall, and taking the maximum inscribed axis-parallel segment.

End-first trials reset one medium 0.010 m above the center aperture, long axis within 5 deg of floor normal, at zero velocity. Passage requires its center to cross from above to 0.005 m below the floor through that aperture within 2 s, with no rib-contact segment exceeding 0.25 s. Use 20 deterministic azimuths.

Transverse trials use the same reset with the long axis within 5 deg of the floor plane. Bridge-release trials first require no passage for 1 s, then replay ±4 deg roll at 1 Hz for 3 s; release requires a clear-aperture crossing. Reset bodies, events, and accumulators for every trial.

Washer escape trials place one intact washer 0.005 m above the center aperture at 40 deterministic orientations spanning face-on, edge-on, and intermediate attitudes. Bore-lodging trials place a media nose against a washer bore at 20 deterministic relative azimuths, apply gravity for 2 s, lift the washer 0.02 m, and classify lodging if the medium remains mechanically carried for 1 s without robot contact.

Bilateral grip is true only when colliders from both named finger/palm sets have resolved positive-normal-force contact with authored screen grasp-tab colliders. Any false 240 Hz sample resets the duration.

Loaded-screen lift height is the minimum world-z point of S collision geometry minus its settled-reset value. A hold sample qualifies only when all M∪W are inside_screen, bilateral grip is true, lift height is at least 0.030 m, no damage/loss event exists, and screen linear speed is at most 0.010 m/s.
Joint margins are evaluated at every 240 Hz sample from the first guarded action through release clearance. Fixed joints are excluded.

Camera checks run on every rendered 20 Hz control frame. Valid RGB pixels are finite and in range; valid depth pixels are finite and positive. Visibility requires unoccluded projected pixels for screen, cup, receiver, and at least one M and W body without identifier overlays.

Refinement replays identical reset seed, transforms, action timestamps, and held 20 Hz actions at 240 and 480 Hz for seeds 0–4. Recovery delta is the maximum paired absolute final-r difference; loss-event delta is the maximum paired absolute immutable-event-count difference.

The trusted evaluator rate is fixed at 20 Hz. Physics rates 240/480 Hz and guarded 14D compatibility remain prospective because runtime-api-preflight and pinned-runtime source snapshots are absent; native compatibility is not claimed.

Scripted experts may read poses, velocities, joints, contacts, and scorer flags while leaving model observations unchanged. Task-object state writes, teleportation, fake welds, collision removal, freezing, and hidden restoring forces are forbidden.

The completed current-scope catalog review found the task distinct from the six designated benchmark inventories but identified substantial ability overlap with closed, unmerged PR684. Novelty remains blocked rather than being claimed.
Impact-on-jobs qualification remains blocked until primary occupational evidence shows this operation is a regular core task for qualifying occupations totaling more than 500,000 US workers.

Feasibility status is blocked. Missing evidence comprises pinned-runtime/API preflight, native component passage and damage tests, YAM grasp/trace validation, occupational qualification, and novelty resolution.
scoring_spec: Freeze reset masses m_b and body sets M,W,S,R,U,C,G,T,O,A. Let M0=Σ_{b∈M∪W}m_b and MM0=Σ_{i∈M}m_i. inside_feed means the center lies inside the feed cup's inner-wall half-spaces and above its floor. inside_screen means the center lies radially inside the screen wall, below the rim, and above the perforated plane except while traversing a connected clear aperture. inside_receiver means the center lies below the receiver rim, above its floor, and inside every inner-wall half-space. Advance each body's FEED→EXITED_FEED→FREE_FLIGHT→ENTERED_SCREEN machine as defined in damage_rules; valid admission is ENTERED_SCREEN with no provenance fault. admitted_mass is the mass of validly admitted bodies and F=clamp(admitted_mass/M0,0,1). batch_loaded latches when all M∪W have valid admission and every washer is inside_screen. A genuine aperture crossing is a downward swept-center segment through the floor plane that intersects exactly one connected clear-space aperture and no rib collider. Passage can occur at any sample after that body's ENTERED_SCREEN state, including after the feed cup becomes empty. eligible_receiver(i,k)=1 only when batch_loaded has latched, medium i has valid admission and a later genuine aperture crossing, is currently inside_receiver, and has never spilled, become inaccessible, intersected a receiver wall, or incurred invalid provenance. Let r(k)=clamp(Σ_{i∈M}m_i·eligible_receiver(i,k)/MM0,0,1); it decreases immediately on receiver exit or newly latched loss. washer_retained requires every intact W assembly currently inside_screen with valid admission and no washer-loss event. supported requires contact with both support beams, lowest screen geometry within 0.002 m of support tops, |roll|≤3 deg, |pitch|≤3 deg, and screen-center projection inside the support footprint. clear requires minimum signed distance from every G collider to S∪M∪W of at least 0.060 m. clean requires no media spill, inaccessible media, contamination, fracture, forbidden edit, or invalid provenance. Q(k)=1 iff batch_loaded, F=1, r≥0.98, washer_retained, supported, clear, and clean. A dwell begins at k0 when Q first becomes true; elapsed=(k-k0)/240 s, so the first qualifying sample contributes zero. D(k)=1 only after uninterrupted k-k0≥720. Any false Q immediately resets the dwell and revokes D. Base score B=0.20F+0.70·clamp(r/0.98,0,1)+0.10D. Hard failure or invalid provenance overrides score=0. Otherwise score=min(B,0.40 if washer damage is active,0.20 if apparatus fracture is active), omitting inactive caps. Report at 20 Hz from the latest completed physics sample and process O_57600 before timeout. Untouched score is 0; F=1,r=0,D=0 scores 0.20; with 12 of 24 equal-mass media recovered r=0.5 and score=0.5571428571; F=1,r≥0.98 without dwell scores 0.90; valid dwell scores 1.00. Full success requires final score 1.00. Hand identity, action count, shake count, and prescribed order are not graded.

required_controls.name: untouched_reset_zero_score_control
required_controls.reason: No body has a valid admission record, so F=r=D=0.

required_controls.name: valid_batch_loaded_no_recovery_control
required_controls.reason: F=1, r=0, and D=0 gives 0.20.

required_controls.name: physical_half_media_recovery_control
required_controls.reason: Exactly 12 of 24 equal-mass media recovered gives r=0.5 and score 0.20+0.70(0.5/0.98).

required_controls.name: valid_threshold_recovery_unreleased_control
required_controls.reason: F=1 and r≥0.98 without qualifying dwell gives 0.90.

required_controls.name: valid_released_supported_dwell_control
required_controls.reason: All prerequisites plus 720 continuous physics intervals gives D=1 and score 1.00.

required_controls.name: timeout_exact_720_interval_dwell_control
required_controls.reason: Q true from O_56880 through O_57600 spans exactly 720/240 seconds.

required_controls.name: timeout_719_interval_dwell_control
required_controls.reason: Q true from O_56881 through O_57600 spans only 719/240 seconds.

required_controls.name: cup_exit_free_flight_screen_entry_control
required_controls.reason: All bodies causally exit the cup, traverse multi-sample free flight, and later enter the screen, establishing F=1 without recovery.

required_controls.name: post_cup_empty_agitation_recovery_control
required_controls.reason: Valid aperture crossings after the cup becomes empty remain eligible and can produce r≥0.98.

required_controls.name: direct_cup_to_receiver_shortcut_control
required_controls.reason: Receiver entry before screen admission permanently invalidates provenance.

required_controls.name: separately_staged_washers_shortcut_control
required_controls.reason: Staging a washer outside the causal admission path permanently invalidates provenance.

required_controls.name: individually_staged_media_shortcut_control
required_controls.reason: Individual robot contact or external staging permanently invalidates provenance.

required_controls.name: washer_loss_zero_override_control
required_controls.reason: One immutable washer-loss event invokes the hard-failure override.

required_controls.name: receiver_contamination_zero_override_control
required_controls.reason: Any non-media task body entering the receiver invokes the hard-failure override.

required_controls.name: apparatus_fracture_low_base_control
required_controls.reason: For B=0.10, the 0.20 apparatus cap leaves 0.10.

required_controls.name: apparatus_fracture_high_base_control
required_controls.reason: For B=0.5571428571, the 0.20 apparatus cap yields 0.20.

required_controls.name: washer_damage_low_base_control
required_controls.reason: For B=0.20, the 0.40 washer-damage cap leaves 0.20.

required_controls.name: washer_damage_high_base_control
required_controls.reason: For B=0.5571428571, the 0.40 washer-damage cap yields 0.40.

required_controls.name: all_media_spilled_after_loading_control
required_controls.reason: Historical F=1 remains, but r=0 and D is permanently ineligible.

required_controls.name: post_success_clearance_revocation_control
required_controls.reason: Violating release clearance after success resets Q and D while F=1 and r≥0.98 remain.

required_controls.name: forbidden_state_mutation_zero_override_control
required_controls.reason: A forbidden write, weld, collider disable, freeze, or hidden force invokes the hard-failure override.
